title: Severed-wire audit of src/tools: dead tool-server API, dead repair machinery, and a legacy hook decorator

findings.title: AlephToolServer carries a large dead API surface: only new()/replace_tool()/list_tools_arc() are live
findings.rationale: Read-first triage: the only production callers of AlephToolServer are new() (markdown_skills.rs Lazy), replace_tool() (markdown_skills.rs:370 and start/mod.rs:2228 via the SkillWatcher reload callback), and list_tools_arc() (markdown_skill_tools.rs:54). Every other method has zero live callers: call(), call_with_repair(), try_repair_tool_name(), add_tool(), add_tool_arc(), tool(), tool_boxed(), replace_tool_arc(), remove_tool(), has_tool(), get_definition(), list_definitions(), list_names(), len(), is_empty(), clear(), new_with_skills(), and handle() (AlephToolServerHandle is itself referenced nowhere outside the tools module). Markdown-skill execution reaches the tool through MarkdownLoopTool::execute -> AlephToolDyn::call, never through AlephToolServer::call, so the call/repair half of the server is pure dead scaffolding. The orphaned repair machinery (server/repair.rs to_snake_case/call_with_repair_impl/try_repair_tool_name_impl) is reachable only from these dead methods, and the ToolRepairInfo/ToolRepairType types exist only as its return type. Delete the dead methods + handle type + repair module + their tests, keeping new()/replace_tool()/list_tools_arc() and the shared ops they still use (replace_tool_arc_impl, list_tools_arc_impl). Note the painless-wire heuristic: the repair path has never been on the markdown-skill execution path and nothing reports it missing.

findings.title: ToolUpdateInfo::is_new()/is_replacement() and old_description are dead accessors
findings.rationale: Read-first triage: replace_tool() has two live callers (markdown_skills.rs:370, start/mod.rs:2228), and both read only the was_replaced field. is_new() and is_replacement() have zero callers anywhere (the only other is_new()/is_replacement() hits are unrelated orchestrator::Resolver and voice-streaming local variables). old_description is populated by replace_tool_arc_impl but never read by any caller. Cut the two accessors and the old_description field (or keep the struct minimal to what the callers read). This is part of the same dead-tool-server cluster as finding 1 but anchored at the types file.

findings.title: ToolHookDecorator legacy observational hook path has no production consumer
findings.rationale: Read-first triage: with_hook_decorator() has zero callers outside scoped/tests.rs (the only production hook wiring is with_hook_executor(), fed by tool_service_builder.rs:135 through the modern HookExecutor path). The hook_decorator field is read in dispatch.rs (before_execute/after_execute/after_execute_with_duration), but nothing ever sets it in production, so the entire observational decorator chain is dormant. ToolHookDecorator is still re-exported from tools::scoped as a public extension point, but no in-repo or documented external caller constructs one; the modern HookExecutor Before/AfterToolCall interceptors supersede it. Cut the trait, with_hook_decorator, the hook_decorator field, and the three dispatch call sites; keep the ToolDefinitionRewriter half of scoped/traits.rs, which is live (progressive_disclosure and tool_service_builder).
